title: 🏦 State Bank of India — ₹10.9L Cr Market Cap (#4 in India) & $1B MUFG Social Loan
theme: Public Sector Banking Scale & Sustainable Finance
executiveSummary: SBI raised $1 billion through 5-year social loan from Japan's MUFG, the first social loan raised by an Indian bank.
masterKeyFacts: SBI raised $1 billion through 5-year social loan from Japan's MUFG, the first social loan raised by an Indian bank.
SBI market cap crossed ₹10.9 lakh crore, surpassing TCS (₹10.5L Cr) to rank 4th (Reliance > HDFC Bank > Bharti Airtel > SBI).
SBI aims for 7.5-10% green advances by 2030 and launched CHAKRA Centre of Excellence for renewable energy and green hydrogen.
